name: pilot_confirm_texts
for: API (workflow), Hosting (four test mails to the staging sink only), Audit
basis: owner decisions 23.11. (ec4181ed): confirmation mail for Growth and Enterprise = yes; no '24 h' in mail or on screen. Text source: docs/website_redesign/mail/COPY_TO_API_AUDIT_1123_CONFIRMATION_MAIL_GROWTH_ENTERPRISE_v1.md
status: final wording. Editorial and technical check, not a legal approval.

placeholders.{name}: the form's name field; if empty, use greeting_no_name
placeholders.{agency}: the form's agency field; if empty, use arrived_no_agency

language_rule: the language of the page the request was sent from (/es or /en); if unknown: es
rules: no clock time and no deadline
send only for interest = demo (Growth) and interest = talk (Enterprise)
tests only to the staging sink, never to a real customer
